name: @epoch/e2e-slices
description: W031 Reference E2E slices: deterministic in-process cross-surface proof layer. Five named slices (construction-delivery, software-delivery, adapter-intake, action-gateway, recovery) composing REAL workspace packages through their public APIs. NOT a pnpm workspace importer: tests/e2e sits outside the pnpm-workspace.yaml globs (owned surface, root manifests frozen), so this manifest DECLARES the frozen devDependency policy while import resolution happens via vitest resolve.alias + tsconfig paths. Run via: pnpm --filter @epoch/pack-construction exec vitest run --root ../../tests/e2e (see docs/e2e/README.md).
